exposure: Time since delivery (0-3 years postpartum vs. >3 years postpartum)
Mode of delivery (Caesarean section or vaginal delivery)
cohort: 2,260,952 primiparous women aged 18-49 years in South Korea from 2008 to 2018
finding: Cesarean section, older age at first delivery (35-49 years), and having a female infant were associated with an increased risk of developing systemic sclerosis in primiparous women.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was a risk factor for SSc development, especially after 3 years postpartum.
